description: Contract defining the task envelope used by the backend to dispatch validated Forensic IR to a specific JOCKY Agent.
purpose: Bind a validated IR sequence to a specific target agent.
Allow the Agent to retrieve and execute the assigned IR.

investigation_id.description: Identifier linking the task to an investigation.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the target JOCKY Agent.

ir_requirements: IR must conform to Forensic IR Contract v0.1.
IR must be validated before task creation.
Agent must locally re-validate the received IR.
Task must not contain arbitrary native commands.
Task must target a registered agent.

control_plane.purpose: Tell the target machine what authorized forensic operations to perform.

data_plane.purpose: Return collected forensic results and task outcomes.

multi_machine_model.description: One investigation may generate separate tasks for multiple registered agents.
multi_machine_model.rule: Each task is bound to exactly one agent_id.

agent_acceptance_rules: Reject tasks addressed to an unknown agent.
Record task rejection in the agent audit log.
backend_rules: Only validated IR may be placed inside a task.
agent_id must reference a registered agent.
investigation_id must reference the corresponding investigation.
Task status transitions must be auditable.
Task creation timestamp must be recorded.

api_relationship.create_task: Backend creates task after investigation compilation/validation.
api_relationship.poll_task: Agent requests pending task assigned to its agent_id.
api_relationship.evidence_upload: Agent uploads resulting evidence separately through the Evidence contract.

status_notes: This contract follows the MVP task shape defined by the 14-Day execution plan.
The task contains validated IR rather than arbitrary commands.
Evidence is uploaded through the separate Evidence contract.
Detailed authentication and transport mechanisms belong to the Agent/Backend communication design, not this task schema.
